description:
Free Digital Painting Software

FireAlpaca is the free digital painting software compatible with both Mac and Windows, supporting 10 languages. The Windows 64-bit version runs on Windows 10 or later, and Windows, macOS, and Linux versions are all available for free. It provides a lightweight yet powerful painting environment with tools such as the Pose Doll 3D character posing, perspective rulers, a line stabilizer, and text tools.
- Fixed an issue where opening an image file in an unsupported format from the materials window would result in the file being deleted.
- Fixed a bug where clicking the +/- icons in the layer list while holding down the Shift key caused a crash.
